To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
sustainable supply chain management is a complex phenomenon that is constrained by a range of factors.

there is an opportunity to maximise the improved macro scale environmental impact of supply chains by applying the CFM to the supply chain management process, and that the CFM is a useful framework for understanding how to maximise the impact of improved environmental performance.
The theory of constraints is an appropriate lens for analysing supply chain performance.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of behavioural factors in sustainable supply chain management and the theory of constraints.
the theory of constraints in the context of sustainable supply chain development.
the theory of constraints and behavioural aspects of the supply chain.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the theory of constraints is a useful tool for sustainable supply chain management, and the constraining factor model is useful for identifying the factors that constrain the maximisation of improved environmental performance in supply chains.

the theory of constraints and the Constraining Factor Model can be usefully applied in sustainable supply chain management, and that the theory of constraint's constraining factors, particularly exogenous opportunity factors, are important for sustainable supply chains.
the theory of constraints can be used to analyse the constraining factors that prevent the maximisation of improved environmental performance in sustainable supply chains.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the theory of constraints is an important tool for sustainable supply chain management, but that it is necessary to consider behavioural factors as well.
, in the context of the supply chain, the theory of constraining factors can be used to explain why firms do not maximise their improved environmental performance.

, in order to maximise the improved environmental performance of supply chain networks, the exogenous constraining factors of regulatory, macro economic, and socio psychological factors need to be taken into consideration.
The main takeaway from our work is that
behavioural factors are a major constraining factor in the development of sustainable supply chain.
behavioural change is required in order to improve macro scale environmental performance of supply chains.
the theory of constraints and CFM can be used as an analytical framework to understand and improve sustainable supply chain performance.
